storage: Airtight container, cool and dry, away from moisture and insects; refrigerate in monsoon if stored for long.
looksLike: Very fine, soft, bright-white powder with no bran specks that clumps when squeezed (atta is creamier and grittier).
howToPick: Uniformly white, fine and free-flowing; no musty smell, lumps, insects or webbing. Check the pack says maida/refined wheat flour (FSSAI labelling rule, see section 9).
shelfLife: About 3 to 6 months in a sealed pack (general guidance, not from a source this run).
substitutes: Fine atta (whole wheat) or a half-and-half mix
